speech.heard: South Sudan has 88.8% food insecurity, Belarus has 1%. South Sudan is the world's highest. It counts families forced to also reduce the quantity of food they would normally eat. Belarus is the world's lowest, just 1% of people there face these daily struggles. Nigeria has 76.5%, Brazil has 9.6%. The highest rates on Earth, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Sierra Leone, and Haiti, all above 83.5%. The gap is staggering. Nigeria has 76 times the food insecurity of Belarus. The USA has 10.7%. It includes anyone exposed at times during the year to low-quality diets. How secure is the food on your table?
